brand_source: Plano ISD colors as used on the NTXEC session dashboard: maroon #9D2235, charcoal #393C3D, gold #D4A43A. Arial substitutes for the dashboard's web fonts so email renders consistently.
notes: Gold is used only for the accent rule, never for text, because it fails contrast on white. logo_url points to NTXEC's hosted copy for the session dashboard.
